label: EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY
title: District ideas become statewide progress.
description: The EEO Innovative Best Practices Grant Initiative funds district-led approaches that advance equitable hiring, retention, and institutional practice.

label: THE FOUNDATION · 2021
title: $20 million for statewide EEO progress.
description: AB 132 established a one-time EEO Best Practices Fund. Approximately $15.5 million was apportioned to eligible districts in 2021–22.

label: FIRST COMPETITIVE CYCLE · 2023–25
title: $5,651,806 awarded to 21 districts.
description: Competitive grants expanded local experimentation and created practices that other colleges can study and adapt.

label: CURRENT CYCLE · 2026–28
title: $1.4 million across 11 districts.
description: Awards support innovative pre-hiring, post-hiring, and EEO interventions. Five awards are $100,000 and six are $150,000.

label: COMPETITIVE AWARDS SINCE LAUNCH
title: $7,051,806 committed through two cycles.
description: The competitive total is separate from the earlier statewide apportionment, preventing double counting.

label: CURRENT DISTRICT PORTFOLIO
title: Local projects. Shared learning.
description: Eleven districts are testing EEO interventions while building knowledge the broader system can use.
transcript: Current awards are Allan Hancock Joint CCD, Antelope Valley CCD, Citrus CCD, Peralta CCD, and West Valley-Mission CCD at $100,000 each; and Kern CCD, Mt. San Antonio CCD, North Orange County CCD, San Diego CCD, Santa Monica CCD, and State Center CCD at $150,000 each.

label: SUSTAINABLE IMPACT MODEL
title: Investment that compounds.
description: Projects become tested practices. Evidence builds shared capacity. Capacity sustains systemwide EEO progress.
transcript: The initiative connects investment, implementation, learning, and shared capacity to support lasting equal employment opportunity impact.

label: THE WORK CONTINUES
title: IBP Grant Initiative
description: District innovation. Shared evidence. Sustainable impact.
